title: Memory Care Leave of Absence Terms by Suite and Program
content:
The Memory Care Residency Agreement sets four figures for a resident's temporary absence from the suite - a hospital admission, a skilled nursing or rehabilitation stay, or a family visit. Absence length is counted in midnights away; the credit percentage applies to the daily monthly rate.

| Tier | Midnights of a continuous absence not credited | Maximum days credited per continuous absence | Credit per credited day (percent of the daily monthly rate) | Midnights after which the executive director reviews whether the suite continues to be held |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Memory Care Companion Suite with Essential Care | 14 | 30 | 25 | 45 |
| Memory Care Companion Suite with Enhanced Care | 14 | 30 | 25 | 45 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Essential Care | 14 | 30 | 25 | 45 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Enhanced Care | 14 | 30 | 25 | 45 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Advanced Care | 14 | 30 | 25 | 45 |
| Memory Care Deluxe Suite with Advanced Care | 14 | 30 | 25 | 45 |

The figures are uniform across all six tiers: the first 14 midnights of a continuous absence earn no credit, no more than 30 days are credited for one continuous absence, each credited day is worth 25 percent of the daily monthly rate, and the review point is reached at 45 midnights.
